pay_detail: $175 non-refundable registration fee covers housing and dining. Grants and sponsors cover the rest.
name: Badger Dairy Camp
org: Department of Animal and Dairy Sciences, UW-Madison
what_you_do: A residential camp on the UW-Madison campus with hands-on workshops, tours and recreation about the dairy industry. Students also do college prep workshops and stay in a campus residence hall.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Badger Dairy Camp registration form when it opens. Questions: badgerdairycamp@ansci.wisc.edu.
notes: Students stay in the Dejope Residence Hall, two to a room.
